objective: Improve the compact MAX-native detector with a feature pyramid, spatial heads, corrected batch-normalization behavior, and sigmoid class training.

attempts.change: Replace mutually exclusive softmax class training with deployment-matching sigmoid scores.
Train the sigmoid contract cleanly rather than converting a softmax checkpoint.

verdict.reason: None of the v3 runs exceeded the previous compact-detector F1 of 0.22686567164179103. The model learned useful boxes but did not calibrate object and class confidence reliably.

notes: All comparisons use the same deterministic 107-image held-out split.
The clean sigmoid result ruled out checkpoint conversion as the main cause.
No experimental checkpoint was connected to autonomous motion.
